# Code of Conduct — pg-api fork

This repository is a personal, single-maintainer downstream fork of
[new-api](https://github.com/QuantumNous/new-api).

It has no community spaces. There is no issue tracker, no discussion board, no pull
request flow, no chat channel and no mailing list, and none of them are open to outside
participation. A code of conduct governs participation in a community; there is no
community here for one to govern, so this repository adopts none.

The upstream project's own spaces are governed by the upstream Contributor Covenant.
Questions about conduct in those spaces belong to the upstream project, not here.

See `AGENTS.md` → **Project Governance** for the authoritative rules.
